questions.question: What is the purpose of Data-Driven Specification in Robot Framework?

options.text: To separate test/task logic from data, enabling execution with multiple data sets efficiently
To store test data in external databases
options.explanation: Data-Driven is about separating logic from data in the test structure

options.text: To automatically generate test data
options.explanation: Data-Driven uses predefined data sets, not automatic generation

options.text: To run tests faster with parallel execution
options.explanation: Data-Driven is about data separation, not parallel execution

questions.question: How does Data-Driven Specification work?

options.text: A single higher-level keyword represents the workflow; test data is defined as rows of input/output values
Multiple keywords are created for each data set
options.explanation: One keyword is reused with different data sets

options.text: Data is hardcoded in each test case
options.explanation: Data-Driven separates data from logic

options.text: Tests query databases for data at runtime
options.explanation: Data is typically defined in the test file, not queried

questions.question: What settings can be used to define test/task templates? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Test Template or Task Template at suite level in *** Settings ***
[Template] at test/task level
Test Data setting

options.text: [Data] setting at test/task level
options.explanation: Use [Template], not [Data]

questions.question: What is the difference between Test Template and [Template]?

options.text: Test Template at suite level applies to all tests; [Template] at test level applies to individual test
Test Template is for data-driven; [Template] is for behavior-driven
options.explanation: Both are for data-driven; difference is scope

options.text: Test Template is mandatory; [Template] is optional
options.explanation: Both are optional; choice depends on whether template applies to all tests

options.text: They are identical; just different syntax
options.explanation: Scope differs: suite-wide vs individual test

questions.question: Can Test Setup and Test Teardown be used with templates?

options.text: Yes, Test Setup/Teardown can be used together with templates
No, templates replace Setup/Teardown
options.explanation: Setup/Teardown and templates can work together

options.text: Only Test Setup, not Test Teardown
options.explanation: Both Setup and Teardown can be used

options.text: Only with [Template], not Test Template
options.explanation: Both template types support Setup/Teardown

questions.question:
Analyze this example:

```robot
Invalid User Name    invalid     ${VALID PASSWORD}
Invalid Password     ${VALID USER}    invalid
```

How many tests are executed?

options.text: 2 separate tests: Invalid User Name and Invalid Password
1 test with 2 data rows

options.text: 3 tests including the template keyword
options.explanation: Only the named tests are executed

options.text: 0 tests; this is a resource file
options.explanation: This defines executable tests
